metadata.logline: Defying Gerald and Clarissa's cruel mockery, Juliana accepts the mysterious scarred warrior's solemn proposal and is officially wed, choosing exile and dignity over her family's cruelty as they walk out into the light together.
metadata.continuity: Picks up directly from Episode 3's cliffhanger where the Mysterious Bearded Man dropped to one knee before the altar, presenting a ring to Lady Juliana.

units.text: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man's scarred hand holding out the silver band ring.
Medium close-up of Juliana, staring down in disbelief at the offered ring.
Juliana's eyes widen, stunned breath catching in her throat.
Medium shot of Gerald stepping forward from his pew with a smug, sneering grin.
Look at him.
units.speaker: GERALD

units.text: Tight close-up of Gerald's venomous, self-satisfied face.
A penniless nobody for a discarded bride.
units.speaker: GERALD

units.text: Medium shot of Clarissa covering her mouth with her gloved hand, bursting into cruel laughter.
Clarissa giggles spitefully, lowering her gloved hand to gloat.
How fitting.
units.speaker: CLARISSA

units.text: Two-shot of Clarissa and Gerald standing proudly side-by-side in their pew as Clarissa points mocking fingers.
You have finally found a man as worthless as everyone thinks you are.
units.speaker: CLARISSA

units.text: Close-up of Juliana's side profile, hurt glistening in her eyes as the insult cuts deep.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up toward the high arches of the chapel, drawing inward strength.
Juliana closes her eyes briefly and releases a steadying breath.
Low-angle shot looking past the kneeling Mysterious Bearded Man up at Juliana.
You don't even know me.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man gazing upward with unwavering earnestness.
Tight close-up of Juliana's anguished face.
You heard what they think I am.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Medium shot looking down as Juliana addresses the kneeling stranger directly.
Why would you offer me your name?
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Low-angle close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man.
Because I know what I see.
units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN

units.text: Medium close-up of Juliana reacting with a mix of suspicion and wonder.
Intimate tight shot framing Juliana's profile beside his dark silhouette.
And what do you see?
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man.
A woman who was betrayed.
units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN

units.text: Over-the-shoulder shot past the bearded warrior toward Gerald watching nervously from the family pew.
Not a woman who deserves to be discarded.
units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN

units.text: Low-angle medium shot of Juliana bending slightly forward, shaken by his words.
Medium close-up of Juliana.
You don't know what my family has done to me.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Low-angle shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man still on one knee, framed against the stained-glass window.
I know they have made you stand alone.
units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN

units.text: Extreme close-up of the ring held in his weathered fingers, Juliana's white silk gown blurred in background.
You don't have to stand alone now.
units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN

units.text: Medium shot of Juliana, her pride flaring through her sadness.
If this is pity, take back your ring.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Tight close-up on Juliana's face, a tear clinging to her cheek.
I will not become anyone's charity.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man holding her gaze directly.
It is not pity, Lady Juliana.
units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN

units.text: Intense tight close-up on his piercing blue-green eyes and facial scars.
It is a vow.
units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN

units.text: Close-up of Juliana, completely disarmed by the gravity of his promise.
I don't know this man.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Medium shot of Lady Ashcroft, Clarissa, and Lord Ashcroft seated coldly in the family pew.
I don't know what waits beyond these doors.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Side profile close-up of Juliana looking toward her estranged family, then turning back.
But he looked at me when everyone else turned away.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Medium shot of Juliana facing down at him, a faint, tender smile breaking across her lips.
Then I accept.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Wide shot of the altar with the high cathedral stained glass overhead as the Priest looks on between them.
Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man rising smoothly to his feet before Juliana.
The Mysterious Bearded Man stands tall, extending his scarred hand toward Juliana.
Close-up of Juliana's slender hand resting gently into his large, weathered palm.
He folds his fingers over hers, holding her hand with protective firmness.
Medium close-up of the Priest holding his open liturgical book, bewildered and trembling.
My- My Lady...
units.speaker: THE PRIEST

units.text: Tight close-up of the Priest's alarmed, questioning eyes.
Are you certain?
units.speaker: THE PRIEST

units.text: Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft seated in his pew, gripping his cane, bowed in grim silence.
Close-up profile of Juliana, her expression clear and unshakable.
I am.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Medium close-up of the Priest swallowing hard and looking down at his book.
Then... let us proceed.
units.speaker: THE PRIEST

units.text: Close two-shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man and Juliana gazing intimately into each other's eyes.
You need not say anything you do not mean.
units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN

units.text: Close-up of Juliana smiling softly up at him.
I truly mean it.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Close-up shot of his hands sliding the silver ring over her ring finger.
The Mysterious Bearded Man carefully slides the band onto Juliana's finger.
Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man holding her hands tenderly.
You have my protection.
units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN

units.text: Tight shot of the warrior's face, his eyes full of devotion.
You have my respect.
units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN

units.text: Extreme close-up of his intense gaze.
And you have my word.
units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN

units.text: Medium three-shot with the Priest standing between them, raising both hands in blessing over their joined hands.
By the authority entrusted to me, I now pronounce you...
units.speaker: THE PRIEST

units.text: High wide establishing shot looking down from the ceiling vaults of the cathedral onto the altar.
...husband and wife!
units.speaker: THE PRIEST

units.text: Dramatic musical chord swelling.
Medium close-up of Gerald lunging forward, pointing an enraged finger.
You have thrown yourself away!
units.speaker: GERALD

units.text: Tight close-up of Gerald, face contorted in rage.
For a penniless nobody!
units.speaker: GERALD

units.text: Medium two-shot of Juliana standing tall before Gerald in the chapel aisle, her husband standing guard behind her.
I would rather choose my own life...
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Close-up of Juliana, her jaw set with unshakable pride.
...than spend another moment begging for yours.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Tight close-up of Gerald, eyes wide with speechless shock and wounded pride.
Gerald recoils slightly, mouth agape.
Wide shot of Lady Ashcroft rising abruptly from the front pew, pointing an accusatory hand toward the doors.
Do not bring this man anywhere near Ashcroft Manor!
units.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT

units.text: Tight close-up of Lady Ashcroft, eyes blazing with cold malice.
You are disowned!
units.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT

units.text: Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft bowing his head deeply over his cane in shame.
Close-up of Juliana. Tears brim in her eyes at the formal rejection, but she does not break.
Medium two-shot as the Mysterious Bearded Man turns gently to Juliana, reaching his hand out once more.
Come, Lady Juliana.
units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN

units.text: Close-up of Juliana placing her hand securely into his, gripping his scarred hand.
Wide tracking shot behind Juliana and the warrior as they begin walking down the central aisle toward the chapel doors.
Medium three-shot of Gerald, Clarissa, and Lady Ashcroft watching in stunned silence and disbelief.
Clarissa gapes in shock while Lady Ashcroft exhales in exasperation.
Wide shot from the back of the chapel as the massive oak doors swing wide open, revealing bright daylight and the courtyard outside.
Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man walk hand-in-hand through the towering doors into the sunlight together, turning their backs on the ruined wedding as the screen fades out.
Heavy oak doors creaking open, followed by a triumphant musical swell fading out into silence.
